svg.aria-label: Left: how alike every pair of the 128 real position cards is. A bright purple band runs along the diagonal, because neighbouring positions have similar cards; positions far apart are orange, meaning their cards point opposite ways. Right: the real cards for positions 1, 2, 64 and 128, each 128 numbers.
svg.text: The position cards: one fixed card for every position
Real numbers from my trained model. Training turned the cards into a kind of ruler.
how alike each pair of position cards is
Purple: alike. Orange: opposite. The bright diagonal
band means neighbouring positions have similar cards.
Shown as 4 rows of 32. Blue: above 0. Orange: below.
